darkniche: Climatic Dark Diversity and Directional Niche Coverage

Source: R/darkniche-package.R
darkniche-package.Rd

Which species are absent from a region although its climate is inside their tolerance? darkniche answers that question end to end: it estimates niches and regional climate availabilities on one shared environmental lattice, scores climatic admissibility with a directional metric family that expresses containment (a question symmetric overlap statistics such as Schoener's D provably cannot express), screens each pair against three analytical null models, calibrates the admissibility threshold against documented introduced ranges, and reports the resulting dark diversity with the two guardrails the underlying studies found to be indispensable: an area adjustment on the dark-diversity ratio, and a threshold-sweep diagnostic that reveals when the direction of an aggregate null-model test is an artefact of the threshold rather than a property of the region.

Workflow

  1. dn_space(), dn_density() – one lattice, one density per species and per region.

  2. dn_metrics() – the directional family (DNC_q, DNC_auc, NSI_q, CFI, CFI_w, NOV) alongside D, I and BC.

  3. dn_null_breadth(), dn_null_shift(), dn_null_relocate() – null screens; dn_ses() standardises them.

  4. dn_match(), dn_auc(), dn_delong(), dn_calibrate() – validation against documented introduced ranges.

  5. dn_dark(), dn_cddr(), dn_report() – accounting.

  6. dn_aggregate(), dn_sweep(), dn_direction_census() – region-level inference and its diagnostic.

Guardrails

dn_aggregate() suppresses the effect size, p-value and enrichment ratio whenever the expected count falls below five; dn_cddr() returns the area-adjusted residual beside the raw ratio and documents that raw CDDR must not rank regions; dn_sweep() prints a reversal warning from the object itself, computed only from thresholds the test considers reliable.

Example data

dn_data() gives the published results for all 619 WWF terrestrial ecoregions, so every example and test runs on real output.

References

Rahimi, E. & Jung, C. (in review) Directional niche coverage and the climatic dark diversity of Iranian ecoregions.

Rahimi, E. & Jung, C. (in review) Climatic dark diversity of the world's terrestrial ecoregions and the threshold dependence of aggregate null-model tests.
